proof_body:
by
  intro A _ _
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro f hf
  rw [← Ideal.jacobson_bot, Ideal.mem_jacobson_bot] at hf
  by_contra hf0
  have hf0' : f ≠ 0 := by simpa using hf0
  have := hf Polynomial.X
  have hd := Polynomial.natDegree_eq_zero_of_isUnit this
  have h1 : (f * Polynomial.X + 1).natDegree = f.natDegree + 1 := by
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_add_eq_left_of_natDegree_lt]
    · rw [Polynomial.natDegree_mul_X hf0']
    · rw [Polynomial.natDegree_mul_X hf0']; simp
  omega
